author: Paramount Plus
description:
It Gets Worse premieres November 6 on the Paramount+ Premium Plan.

After being evicted from their flat, three deeply non-aspirational twenty-somethings stumble through dead-end jobs, chaotic love lives, and worsening mental health, clinging to friendship while the world – and their futures – falls apart around them. No money, no direction and absolutely no idea how to get their shit together. Surely it gets better than this, right? Spoiler alert: it doesn’t.

It Gets Worse is created and exec produced by Leo Reich and stars Reich, Emily Fairn (“House of Guinness”), Olive Gray (“Halo”) and Sean Delaney (“Killing Eve”) among its cast as well as guest stars including Lena Dunham and Andrew Scott.
